description: This file implements server-side logic for the AdminQueue page in an online examination system, handling session validation, database checks of course queues, and navigation controls.

classes.name: AdminQueue
classes.description: Code-behind class for the AdminQueue ASP.NET page, managing course queue operations and navigation for the admin interface.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; validates session variables, checks course queue existence, and potentially clears related data.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the same page (possibly for refreshing or staying on the current page).

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the admin leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by navigating to the login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection changes in a GridView, storing selected student and course IDs in session, then navigating to a detailed answer display page.
